title: 『今宵の月は満月か、三日月か』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Maruzensky trains, she knows she'll never be able to return to her heyday. Despite this, she is making steady progress in her preparations for the Japan Cup she promised to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, Sakura Chiyono O has been losing her appetite and her body feels heavy. In other words…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's possible her peak is behind her, and the end of her career might be looming in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, it's hard to say what's really happening, and Sakura Chiyono O tries to convince herself that it might all just be due to exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she can't shake off her anxiety. When she asks me if I think she can still make it as Maruzensky's rival, her question sounds more like a desperate plea.
